title: Jets scrambled from Santa Cruz and Anápolis on the Night of UFOs
place_text: Santa Cruz, Rio de Janeiro and Anápolis, Goiás, Brazil

tellings.quote: And those jets flew from the base in Santa Cruz in the state of Hanei and from the Anapoulos air base in Guayis in the attempt to intercept the UFOs.

plain: On one night in 1986 that Brazilians call the Night of UFOs, Brazil's air force sent fighter jets up after unknown objects in the sky. Aldo Rebelo, a former Brazilian defense minister, says the jets took off from the Santa Cruz air base in Rio de Janeiro state and the Anápolis air base in Goiás state "in the attempt to intercept the UFOs." Coming from a former defense minister, it amounts to an official confirmation that the military took the sightings seriously.
